payload.title: A power to prescribe a limit is not the prescribed limit
payload.core_explanation_md:
Section464 allows the relevant number to be prescribed within its statutory maximum of100. The official MCA indexed Rule10 text identifies the prescribed ceiling of50for the described gain-seeking association/partnership, unless registered as a company or formed under another applicable law. The textbook treats100as the operative prescribed number; those two numbers answer different questions.

Check the statutory exceptions, including the specified HUF and professionally governed association categories, and the legal form before applying a ceiling. An LLP is formed under a different statute and must not be treated as an ordinary unincorporated firm for this purpose. Full current-rule consolidation and exemption review remain pending because direct MCA PDF retrieval failed; this draft records the evidence limitation explicitly.

self_check.prompt_text: Does a statutory authority to prescribe up to100prove that100is the actual prescribed limit?
self_check.expected_takeaway: No. Read the operative rule and its exceptions separately.

payload.stem_md: An ordinary gain-seeking association has55persons and is stipulated not to be a company, an LLP or within any exception. A note accepts it solely because55is below the section 464delegation maximum of100. What is the issue?

options.text_md: The delegation maximum always replaces the rule
options.explanation_md: The prescribed number must be checked separately.

options.text_md: Every group of55must be a company automatically
options.explanation_md: Legal formation is not inferred solely from headcount.

options.text_md: The operative Rule10ceiling is distinct from the maximum delegation power
options.explanation_md: Under the stated evidence, the prescribed50ceiling must be considered.

options.text_md: The number of bank accounts determines the limit
options.explanation_md: Accounts do not determine membership compliance.

payload.correct_explanation_md: Under the stated evidence, the prescribed50ceiling must be considered.

payload.stem_md: An LLP is assumed to violate an ordinary-firm ceiling solely because its partner count is higher. Which qualification needs analysis?

options.text_md: Its formation under the LLP statute and the applicable statutory/rule scope
options.explanation_md: The legal form and exception wording matter.

options.text_md: The ordinary-firm rule automatically overrides every other formation law
Every partner must therefore be a minor
A larger office automatically removes all statutory requirements
options.explanation_md: Office size is not the legal test.

payload.correct_explanation_md: The legal form and exception wording matter.
